note: Team notes for the pilot day, from the Zocus WhatsApp group, plus what Claude read from the recordings at each refresh. One entry per conversation, keyed by the conversation number. Fields: rep (nickname), customer, segment, model / models (as the customer saw them), fuel, colour, quote (yes, no or promised: whether a quotation was given), priorities (what the customer cares about, when the automatic reading is wrong), value (rupees, set by hand), remarks (shown on the conversation), prices (what was quoted: m = model or variant, p = rupees or text, b = basis, at = time in the recording), tr_en (English for key transcript lines, keyed by the line's time), csv (any CSV column to override, for example objection_quote_en), stage (exploring, finalising or after_booking), payment, kind (delivery = a conversation after the sale, not a sales pitch), result_label, drop (true to leave the call out) with why.

264.remarks: Delivery-day conversation, not a sales pitch. The customer was taking delivery of a Scorpio N today and choosing accessories, which led to a dispute over the ceramic coating bundled into the booking deal. A store colleague helped with accessories, and the rep took phone calls part-way through. The customer raised cancelling the whole car over this amount (17:14 and 17:25); the rep said the full amount would be returned by cheque.

266.remarks: An early enquiry about electric cars. The customer drives about 50 km a day and was shown the XUV 3XO EV (AX5 and AX7L, 39 kWh); the rep also described the BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S. Questions were about range, warranty, battery replacement, the glass roof, tyres, ground clearance and charging. The customer asked for brochures on WhatsApp (3XO, 9e, 9S, BE 6). No budget, buying date or booking came up, and no quotation was given: prices were said aloud as rough amounts. The customer pressed twice on what the 75% figure is counted from, the company's 650 km claim or 500 km (14:50 and 15:40); the rep said 500. The petrol, diesel and CNG 3XO came up once (8:10) as other versions.
